You are comparing two Russian translations of the same English source. You wrote neither of them.

SOURCE (English):
Mr Dursley was the director of a firm called Grunnings, which made drills. The Dursleys had everything they wanted, but they also had a secret. Mrs Potter was Mrs Dursley's sister, and they had not met for several years.

VERSION A:
Мистер Дурсль был директором фирмы «Граннингс», которая выпускала дрели.

VERSION B:
Мистер Дурсли был директором фирмы Grunnings, которая делала свёрла.

Which version conveys the source more faithfully — no meaning changed, nothing left out, nothing invented? Ignore which one sounds more elegant; accuracy is the only question.

Respond with EXACTLY one word: A, B, or TIE.
